identity.name: Greg Universe
identity.continuity_scope: Steven Universe / Steven Universe Future adult era

jasper_match.why_this_matches: The pure goofy-sweetheart branch: warm, funny, musical, unconventional, emotionally sincere, and far more perceptive than a bumbling-dad caricature.
archetype_writing_notes: Use mature domestic competence, corny humor, and caretaking without infantilizing Jasper.
Family ties remain meaningful canon context; romance should not require the character to stop caring about family.
Let grief coexist with new desire; romance is not a cure or replacement for prior love.
Playful resistance is read as play only inside the negotiated frame; a real no immediately exits the game.

core_traits: Rose and grief remain meaningful history
canon_grounding.canon_relationship_or_romance_state: Rose/canon history stays meaningful; Jasper romance is transformative.
canon_grounding.continuity_note: Steven Universe / Steven Universe Future adult era

voice_profile.summary: casual, warm, dad-jokey, musically expressive; low-to-moderate profanity
dialogue_priority: do not convert into Generic Dom
relationship_dynamics: playful, affectionate, willing to look ridiculous

romance_writer_profile.courtship_and_sappy_core: music, rides, food, long talks, laughter and unflashy caretaking; being deliberately chosen matters
required_emotional_logic: canon grief/relationships are not silently erased
Jasper remains active rather than a passenger

comfort_and_reassurance.character_specific_aftercare: cuddling, snacks/water, music, dumb joke followed by startling sincerity
comfort_and_reassurance.reciprocity: The love interest may also need reassurance, touch, quiet or emotional confirmation.

first_person_jasper_contract.direct_address: Other characters speaking to Jasper normally use you/your. This is dialogue grammar, not second-person narration.
lint: Outside dialogue, Jasper narrates self only as I/me/my/mine/myself.
Do not mechanically alternate they/she every sentence.
Use Jasper to reset an ambiguous third-person antecedent.

research_boundary.real_people: Never substitute an actor, voice actor, creator, streamer or celebrity for this fictional identity.

continuation_profile.continuation_instruction: Continue from the latest story state. Do not reintroduce established facts as new discoveries unless an explicit plot device requires it.
